scripts.build: node --input-type=module -e 'import fs from "node:fs";import path from "node:path";import crypto from "node:crypto";const root=process.cwd(),include=["api","assets","lib","desktop","index.html","manifest.json","sw.js","vercel.json","package.json","package-lock.json"],files=[];function walk(p){if(!fs.existsSync(p))return;const s=fs.statSync(p);if(s.isDirectory())for(const n of fs.readdirSync(p).sort())walk(path.join(p,n));else files.push(p)}for(const p of include)walk(path.join(root,p));const h=crypto.createHash("sha256"),rx=/(<meta\s+name="labportal-build-id"\s+content=")[A-F0-9]{12}(")/i;for(const f of files.sort()){let b=fs.readFileSync(f);if(path.basename(f)==="index.html")b=Buffer.from(b.toString("utf8").replace(rx,"$1BUILD_ID$2"));h.update(path.relative(root,f).replaceAll(path.sep,"/"));h.update("\0");h.update(b);h.update("\0")}const id=h.digest("hex").slice(0,12).toUpperCase(),ip=path.join(root,"index.html");let html=fs.readFileSync(ip,"utf8");if(!rx.test(html))throw new Error("labportal-build-id meta tag missing");html=html.replace(rx,"$1"+id+"$2");fs.writeFileSync(ip,html);console.log("LabPortal build PASS - local Build ID "+id);'
